verdict.rationale: Polar's docs describe no-code Checkout Links that are configured once in the dashboard and shared anywhere (website, social, email, buttons), with Polar handling the rest. The no-code nature is reinforced by the overview of checkout surfaces, and Merchant-of-Record onboarding and a free Starter plan support starting to sell quickly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the link-creation flow, and detailed documentation of the time-to-first-sale (account/payout verification steps before going live).
